response.sql:
WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), bucket_shares AS (
  SELECT timespan,
         bucket_count,
         bucket_count::numeric / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT bucket_count, share
  FROM bucket_shares
  WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bucket_count), 0) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM bucket_shares)) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Each matched riskandmargin record counts once, including multiple risk/margin records for the same order; NULL timespan values form one bucket. The average share is the unweighted mean across distinct buckets, including the NULL bucket.
